provenance: Original code-generated synthetic illustrations; no sample-book artwork or empirical model results.

decomposition.caption: A synthetic additive series and its known generating components: y_t = m_t + s_t + r_t. These are specified components, not an estimated decomposition of ETTh1.
decomposition.alt_text: Four panels show a rising noisy series, its linear trend, a repeating daily sine wave, and zero-centered random noise.

stationarity.caption: Three synthetic processes separate stable dependence from nonstationarity. Panel (a) is initialized from its stationary distribution; the random walk has variance that grows with time; panel (c) changes variance halfway through. Appearance alone cannot establish stationarity.
stationarity.alt_text: Three time plots compare a stable autoregression oscillating around zero, a wandering random walk, and zero-mean noise that becomes much more variable halfway through.

uncertainty.caption: Exact marginal Gaussian prediction intervals for a synthetic random walk with known drift and innovation variance. One realized path cannot establish calibration, and pointwise 95% intervals do not imply 95% simultaneous path coverage.
uncertainty.alt_text: A historical series ends at an origin, after which a dashed median rises with two widening shaded bands and one realized future path.

learning_regimes.caption: Where statistical strength is shared: a local fit uses one series, a global fit learns across a panel, and a pretrained checkpoint can be reused with new context. The last row shows zero-shot inference; fine-tuning adds task-specific weight updates. These are learning regimes, not exclusive architecture classes.
learning_regimes.alt_text: Three rows compare one-series local fitting, shared training across many series, and broad-corpus pretraining followed by use of a reusable checkpoint on new context.
